8: # Browser Automation with agent-browser
9: 
10: ## Priority Note
11: 
12: For fetching Rust/crate information, use this priority order:
13: 1. **rust-learner skill** - Orchestrates actionbook + browser-fetcher
14: 2. **actionbook MCP** - Pre-computed selectors for known sites
15: 3. **agent-browser CLI** - Direct browser automation (last resort)
16: 
17: Use agent-browser directly only when:
18: - actionbook has no pre-computed selectors for the target site
19: - You need interactive browser testing/automation
20: - You need screenshots or form filling
21: 
22: ## Quick start
23: 
24: ```bash
25: agent-browser open <url>        # Navigate to page
26: agent-browser snapshot -i       # Get interactive elements with refs
27: agent-browser click @e1         # Click element by ref
28: agent-browser fill @e2 "text"   # Fill input by ref
29: agent-browser close             # Close browser
30: ```
31: 
32: ## Core workflow
33: 
34: 1. Navigate: `agent-browser open <url>`
35: 2. Snapshot: `agent-browser snapshot -i` (returns elements with refs like `@e1`, `@e2`)
36: 3. Interact using refs from the snapshot
37: 4. Re-snapshot after navigation or significant DOM changes
38: 
39: ## Commands
40: 
41: ### Navigation
42: ```bash
43: agent-browser open <url>      # Navigate to URL
44: agent-browser back            # Go back
45: agent-browser forward         # Go forward
46: agent-browser reload          # Reload page
47: agent-browser close           # Close browser
48: ```
49: 
50: ### Snapshot (page analysis)
51: ```bash
52: agent-browser snapshot        # Full accessibility tree
53: agent-browser snapshot -i     # Interactive elements only (recommended)
54: agent-browser snapshot -c     # Compact output
55: agent-browser snapshot -d 3   # Limit depth to 3
56: ```
57: 
58: ### Interactions (use @refs from snapshot)
59: ```bash
60: agent-browser click @e1           # Click
61: agent-browser dblclick @e1        # Double-click
62: agent-browser fill @e2 "text"     # Clear and type
63: agent-browser type @e2 "text"     # Type without clearing
64: agent-browser press Enter         # Press key
65: agent-browser press Control+a     # Key combination
66: agent-browser hover @e1           # Hover
67: agent-browser check @e1           # Check checkbox
68: agent-browser uncheck @e1         # Uncheck checkbox
69: agent-browser select @e1 "value"  # Select dropdown
70: agent-browser scroll down 500     # Scroll page
71: agent-browser scrollintoview @e1  # Scroll element into view
72: ```
73: 
74: ### Get information
75: ```bash
76: agent-browser get text @e1        # Get element text
77: agent-browser get value @e1       # Get input value
78: agent-browser get title           # Get page title
79: agent-browser get url             # Get current URL
80: ```
81: 
82: ### Screenshots
83: ```bash
84: agent-browser screenshot          # Screenshot to stdout
85: agent-browser screenshot path.png # Save to file
86: agent-browser screenshot --full   # Full page
87: ```
88: 
89: ### Wait
90: ```bash
91: agent-browser wait @e1                     # Wait for element
92: agent-browser wait 2000                    # Wait milliseconds
93: agent-browser wait --text "Success"        # Wait for text
94: agent-browser wait --load networkidle      # Wait for network idle
95: ```
96: 
97: ### Semantic locators (alternative to refs)
98: ```bash
99: agent-browser find role button click --name "Submit"
100: agent-browser find text "Sign In" click
101: agent-browser find label "Email" fill "user@test.com"
102: ```
103: 
104: ## Example: Form submission
105: 
106: ```bash
107: agent-browser open https://example.com/form
108: agent-browser snapshot -i
109: # Output shows: textbox "Email" [ref=e1], textbox "Password" [ref=e2], button "Submit" [ref=e3]
110: 
111: agent-browser fill @e1 "user@example.com"
112: agent-browser fill @e2 "password123"
113: agent-browser click @e3
114: agent-browser wait --load networkidle
115: agent-browser snapshot -i  # Check result
116: ```"}}
